title: The standard is not proclaimed. It is sustained.
html:
ASA Dental

Wed. 25. November 2026

share save

Every morning, the same instruments. And a question that no professional voices out loud: will they perform today as they did yesterday? An instrument that fails to hold its performance during a procedure is not a technical problem; it is a clinical one. That is why the quality of a dental device is measured not only by the exceptional piece, but by its reliability over time. This is the ground on which ASA Dental has been working since 1961.

Reliability originates in scale. The company is the world leader by production volume in saliva ejectors, with more than one billion units a year made through the same verified process. No one manufactures as many; no one verifies the same tolerance a comparable number of times. When consistency reaches this order of magnitude, it ceases to be a quality of the product and becomes a yardstick for the industry: on this point, ASA Dental is the benchmark standard.

The same standard governs the instrumentation: from Maniago, a district that combines six centuries of craft culture with a density of specialised expertise that cannot be improvised elsewhere. The supply chain is entirely Italian, from raw material to finishing. Attention to and care for production have always been at the centre: the evolution of the facilities and CNC turning do not replace them; they make them consistent. Dedicated sharpening robots make it possible to work different steel grades with superior characteristics. A correct cutting profile is a result; the same cutting profile on every piece, in every batch, year after year, is a norm.

Final inspection takes place in Bozzano, where finishing, polishing and buffing precede a systematic check before the instrument leaves the company. The logistics centre relies on a fully automated storage system. ISO 13485 certification, testing on every batch, a warranty extended beyond the industry standard: quality is not a claim; it is the documented confirmation of those who commission it.

“We do not produce according to two different philosophies,” says Alessandro Malfatti, CEO of ASA Dental. “We apply a single acceptance criterion to two distinct requirements. Saliva ejectors must be identical - a billion times a year. Instrumentation must withstand years of work without error, always reliable. Governing both productive logics by the same principle of value is what we call the standard.”

It is the same discipline that drives the indirect relationship with the healthcare professional. A catalogue of great depth, covering the entire range of clinical instrumentation and single-use products, to reduce fragmentation and simplify practice management; a direct presence in more than one hundred and seventy countries, to which ASA Dental responds with dedicated people, not with procedures that put things off until later. Before, during and after. Ask your trusted dental dealer.

Because behind every clinical gesture lies a person’s health. And the care with which we offer an instrument is the measure we take pride in.

Italian instrumentation. Consistent precision.

ASA Dental - The Standard in Care
